lesson_title.es: Aprende el proceso con Western Union
lesson_title.en: Learn the process with Western Union

lesson_disclaimer.es: Guía educativa independiente de REMESAS. No es capacitación oficial de Western Union.
lesson_disclaimer.en: Independent educational guide by REMESAS. It is not official Western Union training.

teaches.es: Dónde comienza normalmente una operación y qué debes identificar antes de continuar.
teaches.en: Where a transaction normally begins and what you should identify before continuing.

teaches.es: Selecciona el país al que quieres enviar y verifica qué opciones aparecen.
teaches.en: Select the destination country and verify which options appear.

teaches.es: Aprende a distinguir la cantidad enviada de la cantidad que puede recibir el destinatario.
teaches.en: Learn to distinguish the amount sent from the amount the recipient may receive.

teaches.es: Revisa los métodos de entrega que el proveedor muestre para esa operación.
teaches.en: Review the delivery methods the provider shows for that transaction.

teaches.es: Revisa las formas de pago que el proveedor permita en ese momento.
teaches.en: Review the payment methods the provider allows at that time.

teaches.es: Comprende qué información puede solicitar el proveedor para identificar al destinatario.
teaches.en: Understand what information the provider may request to identify the recipient.

teaches.es: Antes de confirmar, revisa cantidad, tarifa, tipo de cambio, entrega y destinatario.
teaches.en: Before confirming, review amount, fee, exchange rate, delivery, and recipient.

teaches.es: La operación se completa directamente con Western Union. REMESAS no la ejecuta.
teaches.en: The transaction is completed directly with Western Union. REMESAS does not execute it.

learning.official_check: Confirm current requirements, prices, delivery methods, availability and transaction details directly with Western Union.

Confirma siempre la información actual directamente con el proveedor antes de realizar una transferencia.
notice.en: REMESAS by May Roga LLC is an independent informational and educational service. Western Union, MoneyGram, Remitly, and Xoom are trademarks and services of their respective owners.
